title: TopologyGraph
description: Generic topology graph usable at multiple scopes (org/site/device). At org scope, nodes are usually sites; at site scope, nodes are devices (optionally interfaces); at device scope, nodes are components/interfaces.

nodes.description: Graph vertices. The meaning of each node depends on the scope of the request (org/site/device).

id.description: Unique within this graph response. May be a UUID (e.g., for devices/sites) or a composite ID (e.g., 'dev:<uuid>#if:Gi1/0/24' for interfaces).

label.description: Human-friendly label (site name, hostname, interface name, etc.).

ref.description: Optional reference to an underlying resource.

id.description: Canonical identifier of the referenced resource (UUID or composite for interfaces).

properties.description: Optional attributes (e.g., vendor, model, speed, VLAN). Keys and values are implementation-defined.

layer.description: Layer of the relationship represented by this edge.

relation.description: Optional semantics for the relationship. Suggested values: 'adjacent' (site↔site), 'connects' (device↔device or interface↔interface), 'contains' (container relations), 'memberOf'.

properties.description: Optional attributes for this edge (e.g., link speed, VLAN, L3 protocol).
